decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits at the core of the firm's air-cooling offer and has been publicly promoted for two years, so management treats modest uptake as ramp-up in a growing industry and stays committed.
After dropping the overlapping Product C, the remaining air cooled condenser carries the firm's commitment to this segment and its efficiency direction, which justifies persisting with it.
The liner for corroded tubes supports the lifecycle service business the firm emphasizes, and its slower adoption cycle lets results be read as temporary, so it stays.
The tube end repair inserts are low-cost to maintain, complement the service and spare-parts portfolio, and reinforce lifecycle commitments to customers, so management keeps them.
